entities.name: Peasant Emancipation & Early Reforms
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Emancipation of Estonian peasants without land in Estland (1816) and Livland (1819). Gradual peasant land purchases, the emergence of an Estonian-speaking rural middle class, and the first stirrings of cultural identity.
